concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-drop-in-customization-ios-v7]] - 2026-09-16 website snapshot from an iOS v7 Drop-in customization route, retained for lifecycle and SDK-routing notices; the route is not evidence of iOS v7 Drop-in support
